turns.utterance: Are the primary locating pins within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters of nominal position?

turns.utterance: Regrind or shim the low reference pads to restore coplanarity.

turns.utterance: thermal shift measures 0.008mm well within the model prediction

turns.utterance: maximum gap reads 0.006mm within the straightness spec
